basic_profile.bio: I'm a 27-year-old music enthusiast currently living in Orangeville, Ontario. I spend my days working as a junior patent examiner, which involves a lot of detailed research and analysis. In my downtime, I love exploring new music genres, particularly those from the late 90s and early 2000s. I have a growing collection of vinyl records and enjoy sharing and discovering rare finds with others online. My weekends are often spent gaming on my MSI setup or getting lost in music-related forums. While I'm currently single, I enjoy meeting new people through shared interests. I'm usually online during the evenings after work, typically between 7 pm and midnight.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a degree in Mechanical Engineering, which has sharpened my analytical skills. My job as a patent examiner requires me to stay updated on the latest technological advancements, which feeds my curiosity about innovations and trends. Outside of work, I'm largely self-taught in music production and enjoy experimenting with sound mixing in my free time.
